background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background plate for a 3-second animated Sega Genesis side-scrolling scene. Create one empty environment, landscape 4:3 composition, ideally 1280 x 896. A Blade Runner dystopian megacity at night, designed as a lost 1994 Sega Genesis game with the brooding alien-industrial atmosphere of Generations Lost and the detailed side-scrolling stage art of X-Men 2: Clone Wars. Street-level SIDE VIEW, playable horizontal platform across the bottom, not a deep street vanishing point. Dense layered black-blue skyscrapers, distant colossal stepped corporate pyramid, stacked decaying tenements, ribbed biomechanical pipes and tangled hanging cables, cyan and restrained red-orange vertical neon signage, a dim billboard with a woman's face, steam vents and wet metal pavement. Leave the lower central area open to composite 4 small combat sprites later. Walking surface at 82 percent image height, with richly tiled platform sides in bottom 18 percent. Extremely atmospheric and dark but readable. Authentic chunky 16-bit pixel clusters, restricted blue/teal/plum/rust palette, ordered dithering, hard pixel edges, deep parallax layers. Underlying art should feel 320x224 enlarged 4x nearest-neighbor. No characters, no people standing in the environment, no cars, no rain streaks (rain will be animated separately), no HUD, no title, no borders, no watermark, no smooth painted gradients, no photorealism, no modern vector look. This is an original fan-art environment for Blade the vampire hunter and Blade Runner agents hunting vampires and replicants.
sprites:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: animation sprite atlas for a 3-second 16-bit Sega Genesis fan-art video. Create ONE square PNG with GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal square cells. Total sixteen separate full-body character sprites. Every sprite fully inside its own cell with generous transparent padding; no overlap, no grid lines, no text, no drop shadows, no ground. Sprite style: authentic 1994 Sega Genesis, Generations Lost / X-Men 2 Clone Wars, hand-pixeled chunky pixel clusters at about 48x64 native pixels each, about 5 native pixels per displayed pixel cluster, dark comic-book realism, anatomical adults, NO chibi, NO smooth painting. All feet share same baseline within cells, every character same height and consistent scale. Dark blue-black shaded clothing with readable cyan rim lighting and limited crimson highlights.
ROW 1, four animation cels of BLADE THE VAMPIRE HUNTER, a muscular Black man with flat-top haircut, black wraparound sunglasses, black armored vest, black leather trench coat with red lining, sword. ALL FACE RIGHT. Cel 1 guarded stance sword angled forward, cel 2 forward step sword raised overhead coat swinging back, cel 3 deep lunge making a broad horizontal silver sword slash to the right (include short cyan slash arc contained in cell), cel 4 recovering crouch with sword extended low to right. Blade is recognizable and cool, full body.
ROW 2, four animation cels of a BLADE RUNNER REPLICANT HUNTER in a weathered brown trench coat, short brown hair, dark trousers, compact futuristic blaster in both hands, ALL FACE RIGHT. Cel 1 crouched ready, cel 2 aiming straight right, cel 3 firing with small orange muzzle flash, cel 4 recoil coat flapping. Full body, consistent identity.
ROW 3, four animation cels of a PALE VAMPIRE with visible white fangs, glowing red eyes, long dark plum coat, black trousers, white swept-back hair, ALL FACE LEFT. Cel 1 menacing ready, cel 2 lunging left with claws, cel 3 recoiling backward from an impact with bright ember sparks, cel 4 dissolving into a cloud of orange-red ash, recognizable remnant silhouette. No blood, no gore.
ROW 4, four animation cels of a ROGUE REPLICANT, blond buzz cut, pale face, gray futuristic armored jacket, pale blue glowing eyes, ALL FACE LEFT. Cel 1 ready to fight, cel 2 moving left, cel 3 reeling backward from blaster hit with electrical blue sparks, cel 4 kneeling with head lowered and little blue sparks. No blood, no gore.
The sheet must be machine-cuttable: precisely 4x4 regular cells, one sprite centered in each cell. Absolutely transparent background, not a checkerboard illustration.
